snippet.title: Swann's Song — Trailer
snippet.description:
A boy and an old man stand in front a pond, waiting for a swan's song. Meanwhile, they talk about life, death, and the passage of time.

•💬 Dialogue-based short story.
•👦👴 Themes of growing up, life expectations and dealing with regret.
•🦢 45 minutes of waiting for the swan's song.
•🪶 The title is not a typo! Find out why.
•🎨 Art made by hand by Federico Castillo, nominated for Best Poster at the Rome Prisma Independent Film Awards 2024.
•✍️ Story written by Luis León, nominated for the Digital Moment Award at AMAZE Festival 2024 and the Opening Up category at the New Media Writing Prize 2025.
•🎭 The story does not feature multiple endings, it's more of an interactive theatre experience.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3598860/Swanns_Song/
